versions.content: Communication Management shall queue received events and triggers Status: DRAFT Description: Communication Management shall queue received events and triggers with configurable queue length and policy. Rationale: The application wants to ensure that it receives the last n events, n being the queue length. Dependencies: – Use Case: An application polls received events and wants to get the last n events received since the last polling. Supporting Material: –
